summary: Nền tảng AI mã nguồn mở cho phép trò chuyện AI với mọi LLM, hỗ trợ tìm kiếm doanh nghiệp, RAG và vector search.
usecases: Enterprise internal AI assistant with document search and retrieval.
Chatbot integration with multiple LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) for flexible AI interactions.
RAG-based automation for report generation and data summarization.
ideas: Local vector database integration for personal document search assistant.
VS Code plugin for AI-powered code completion and explanation using onyx context.
Self-hosted deployment for teams with strict data privacy requirements.
